title: Voy a…: going to
goal: a contar tus planes con going to: afirmar, negar y preguntar

ex.t: I'm going to call my son tonight.
ex.es: Esta noche voy a llamar a mi hijo.

ex.t: We're going to eat out on Saturday.
ex.es: El sábado vamos a comer fuera.

ex.t: Are you going to come with us?
I'm not going to cook tonight!
Take an umbrella. It's going to rain.
ex.es: Coge un paraguas. Va a llover.

ex.t: What are you going to do this weekend?
ex.es: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?

ex.t: My son is going to come in two weeks.
ex.es: Mi hijo va a venir dentro de dos semanas.

vocab.note: in + tiempo = dentro de. En el Reino Unido también: in a fortnight (en quince días).

ex.t: I'm going to visit my sister in Valencia.
ex.es: Voy a ir a ver a mi hermana a Valencia.

pron.title: going to: el to es débil
pron.tip: En going to, el to suena muy flojito, «tə»: «góuing tə». La fuerza va en el verbo de después: I'm going to VISIT my son.

exercises.q: My son ___ going to come in two weeks.
exercises.why: My son = he: is going to.

exercises.q: We ___ going to eat out on Saturday.
I'm going to ___ my sister in Valencia.
Take an umbrella. It's going ___ rain.

exercises.why: La negativa se hace con not: I'm not going to.

exercises.q: ___ you going to come with us?
What are you going to ___ this weekend?
exercises.es: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?

exercises.q: They ___ going to stay for a week.

exercises.why: Is va delante: Is she going to…?

exercises.q: We're going to buy a new car.
answer: We aren't going to buy a new car.
We're not going to buy a new car.
We are not going to buy a new car.

exercises.q: She's going to calls me tonight.
exercises.why: Después de going to, verbo base, sin -s.

exercises.q: We is going to travel in June.

exercises.es: ¿Vas a ver a tu hijo en Navidad?
exercises.answer: Are you going to see your son at Christmas

exercises.q: No voy a cocinar esta noche.
answer: I'm not going to cook tonight.
I am not going to cook tonight.
exercises.why: No voy a = I'm not going to.

exercises.context: Miras por la ventana: el cielo está negro.
exercises.why: Predicción con pruebas: It's going to rain.
La respuesta corta repite am / is / are.

dialog.title: Planes para el fin de semana
dialog.setting: Yolanda y su amiga Pilar se encuentran en la panadería un viernes

lines.t: What are you going to do this weekend?
lines.es: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?

lines.t: I'm going to visit my sister. And you?
lines.es: Voy a ir a ver a mi hermana. ¿Y tú?

lines.t: My grandchildren are going to stay with me.
lines.es: Mis nietos se van a quedar conmigo.

lines.t: How lovely! Are you going to cook paella?
No, I'm not going to cook. We're going to eat out!
lines.es: No, no voy a cocinar. ¡Vamos a comer fuera!

lines.t: Good idea. Where are you going to go?
To the new pizza place in the square.
lines.es: A la pizzería nueva de la plaza.

lines.t: Your grandchildren are going to love it.
lines.es: A tus nietos les va a encantar.

realLife.t: What are you going to do this weekend?
realLife.es: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?
realLife.context: Para charlar de planes con una amiga

summary: Planes: am / is / are + going to + verbo base
Negativa: I'm not going to cook. She isn't going to drive.
Pregunta: Are you going to come? Is he going to call?
Predicción con pruebas: Look! It's going to rain.
